Hours and Headcount should be added or assigned at the location where the Hours and Headcount actually occurred. Hours and Headcount for child locations will roll up to the parent locations. For example: if your company has five locations in a region or a country you would want to enter the Hours and Headcount at the five individual locations and not at the region or country.
